title: Effective Date of a Named Driver Exclusion, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Conditions
content:
A named driver exclusion on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy takes effect on a date set from the date written on the named driver exclusion form. That date is read against the term expiration date and the day the form is signed.

## Condition

The exclusion's effective date is set as follows, the first matching line deciding:

- **(a)** Where the date written on the form is after the term expiration date, the exclusion takes effect on the term expiration date, so that no day is credited.
- **(b)** Where the date written on the form is earlier than the day the form is signed, it takes effect on the signing day, since an exclusion never takes effect before its signature.
- **(c)** Otherwise, it takes effect on the date written on the form.


## Illustrations (hypothetical; term expiring 1 July 2026; form signed 12 May 2026)

| Date written on the form | Line applied | Exclusion effective | Days to expiration |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 August 2026 | (a) | 1 July 2026 | 0 |
| 1 June 2026 | (c) | 1 June 2026 | 30 |
| 12 May 2026 | (c), same day as signing | 12 May 2026 | 50 |
| 1 May 2026 | (b) | 12 May 2026 | 50 |
